name: Pink Coquette Wink
image_vibe: soft girl coquette, playful pastel editorial
image_purpose: social beauty campaign and editorial fashion concept

prompt.project_info: Create a polished pastel-pink beauty portrait with a playful 2000s-inspired styling language and physical props.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman in a satin pink structured top with modest coverage, pearl necklace, pink translucent sunglasses, soft freckles, pastel eye makeup, and a playful wink while holding a glossy pink lollipop near her lips without licking or biting it.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait from the waist up, centered face and lollipop, symmetrical framing with a slight tilt, flat pink background and shallow depth of field; pink, white, pastel yellow, hot-pink accents.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft beauty-dish studio light, diffused shadows, high-key flattering skin tone, subtle catchlights and controlled gloss on the lollipop.
prompt.technical_specs: Editorial beauty photography, natural soft-focus skin texture, clean color separation, crisp prop detail, vertical portrait composition, no graphic text overlays.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Playful high-key editorial beauty portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman, pastel pink background, modest satin pink structured top, pearl necklace, pink translucent sunglasses, soft freckles, pastel yellow eye makeup, playful wink, holding a glossy pink lollipop near but not contacting the lips, waist-up centered composition, soft beauty-dish lighting, 2000s-inspired clean fashion styling, realistic skin, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized expression, licking, biting, tongue emphasis, fetish framing, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text, distorted hands, extra fingers

assets.name: pink coquette beauty reference

assets.usage: Match the pastel palette, wink, sunglasses, pearl necklace, lollipop prop, modest top coverage, and centered waist-up framing; keep the adult fictional identity and prop colors replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the playful editorial intent, physical-prop styling, composition, and soft lighting. Maintain clearly adult presentation and nonsexual prop handling; identity, wardrobe, and background remain replaceable.
